parole.significato: Any of the large South American serpents from the genus Boa or related genera.
parole.testo: From Sranan Tongo aboma, from Fanti Akan aboma (“large constricting snake”), perhaps via French aboma.

parole.significato: Any of the various small, long-tailed lizards of the subfamily Agaminae of family Agamidae, especially in genera Acanth…
parole.testo: Borrowed from Sranan Tongo agama (“lizard”), borrowed from a Gbe language. Compare Ewe agama (“chameleon”).
